children: CBOT December corn (CZ26) may stabilize around a support at $5.18 and bounce into the $5.21-3/4 to $5.24-1/4 range.

The support is identified as the 100% projection level of wave c from $5.44-1/2, serving as one of this wave's endpoints. Although it is not very clear that this wave would extend to $5.08 or $5.01-3/4, it is may pause around $5.18 and bounce.
A break below $5.18 could open the way toward $5.12 to $5.14-1/4 range.
